info.title: VEIL API
info.description: Public REST API contract for VEIL, a local-first workspace for browsing generated media, inspecting embedded metadata and workflows, managing a virtual library, configuring AI providers, controlling ComfyUI, and running Simple Mode generation. All supported non-legacy `/api/*` routes are represented here. The pre-Simple-Mode `/api/editor/*` workflow editor is intentionally treated as legacy/internal and is excluded from this public contract.

post.summary: Move local assets to OS Trash
post.description: Accepts up to 1000 assets and returns instantly: one atomic commit removes the index rows, records a tombstone per asset and enqueues a trash_assets background job. The OS-trash moves and cache purges run in the job worker; reconciliation skips tombstoned paths.
